Usage: jit [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  init       Initialize through one recoverable publication; an absent data root is staged complete and published without replacing an occupied destination

  apply      Apply a graph template to a container (plan-before-fan-out scaffold)
  dep        Dependency management commands [aliases: dependency]
  gate       Gate management commands
  events     Event log commands
  doc        Document reference commands [aliases: document]
  archive    Preview dependency-aware artifact archival plans
  graph      Graph query commands
  rdeps      Reverse dependencies (top-level alias for `jit graph rdeps`)
  query      Query issues for orchestrators
  label      Label namespace management commands
  config     Configuration commands
  snapshot   Snapshot export commands
  claim      Claim coordination commands
  worktree   Worktree information commands
  hooks      Git hooks installation and management
  item       Addressable structured item commands
  invariant  Invariant enforcement-drift check
  project    Render documentation projections declared in `[projection.*]`
  search     Search issues and documents
  version    Show CLI version and build metadata
  status     Show overall status
  validate   Validate repository integrity and diagnose declared derived-state drift
  recover    Run recovery: apply a leftover redo record, then the repair routines
  migrate    Run one-time data migrations
  serve      Start the JIT API and web UI server as a background process
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -q, --quiet    Suppress non-essential output (for scripting)
      --schema   Export command schema in JSON format for AI agent introspection
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

For JSON output shapes and exit code documentation, run `jit --schema`.

Usage: jit issue [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  create        Create a new issue
  batch-create  Batch-create issues with dependency wiring from a JSON file
  search        Search issues by text query and/or filters

  children      List a container's direct children — its immediate dependencies (depth 1) — each rendered exactly like `issue status`
  progress      Summarize a container's direct children (depth 1) as counts by state plus a done/total delivery rollup
  update        Update an issue or multiple issues. Returns a lightweight confirmation (id, short_id, state, updated_at); run `jit issue show` to fetch the full updated body
  delete        Delete an issue
  assign        Assign issue to someone
  claim         Claim an issue: assign it and promote it to in_progress
  unassign      Unassign an issue
  reject        Reject an issue (convenience for --state rejected)
  release       Release an issue from its assignee (for timeout recovery)
  claim-next    Claim the next available ready issue
  list          List issues (equivalent to `jit query all`)
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -q, --quiet  Suppress non-essential output (for scripting)
